_comment: Note 694's shape with synthetic names. Three children run together; the first block is never named and the second's spoken name ('Polly') matches nobody on the roster. Only the third child is nameable. Forbids the unowned blocks' content, not names: nobody owns those sentences, so they must land in no entry at all. Name-based must_not_quote_substrings cannot see this bug. Every phrase here is unique to its block and cannot arise by paraphrasing the nameable child's own sentences.
